name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small bathroom feel more spacious, consider strategies such as installing a wall-mounted vanity to free up floor space, using large format tiles with minimal grout lines, or incorporating a frameless glass shower enclosure. Light-colored paint, ample lighting, and well-placed mirrors can also visually expand the room. Strategic storage solutions, like recessed shelves or built-in niches, help maintain an uncluttered environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: To enlarge a small bathroom visually, use wall-mounted vanities, large tiles, frameless glass showers, light colors, ample lighting, and smart storage.
